DEPARTMENT OF THE TREASURY

Office of Foreign Assets Control

31 CFR part 560

Publication of Iran-Related Web General Licenses EE and FF.

AGENCY: Office of Foreign Assets Control, Treasury.

ACTION: Publication of web general licenses.

SUMMARY: The Department of the Treasury’s Office of Foreign Assets Control

(OFAC) is publishing two Iran-related general licenses (GLs): GLs EE and FF, which

were made available on OFAC’s website at the time of issuance.

DATES: GL EE was issued on October 8, 2026. See SUPPLEMENTARY

INFORMATION for additional relevant dates.

FOR FURTHER INFORMATION CONTACT: [contact details omitted]



SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION:

Electronic Availability

       This document and additional information concerning OFAC are available on

OFAC’s website: https://ofac.treasury.gov/.

Background

       On October 8, 2026, OFAC issued GL EE to authorize certain transactions

otherwise prohibited by Executive Order 13846 of August 6, 2018, “Reimposing Certain

Sanctions With Respect to Iran” (83 FR 38939, August 7, 2018). GL EE expired on

October 23, 2026. On October 15, 2026, OFAC issued GL FF to authorize certain

transactions otherwise prohibited by the Iranian Transactions and Sanctions Regulations,

31 CFR part 560. GL FF expired on October 30, 2026. These GLs were made available

on OFAC’s website (https://ofac.treasury.gov) when they were issued. The text of these

GLs is provided below.


OFFICE OF FOREIGN ASSETS CONTROL

Executive Order 13846 of August 6, 2018
(“Reimposing Certain Sanctions With Respect to Iran”)

GENERAL LICENSE EE

Authorizing the Wind Down of Transactions Involving Samudra Marine Services
Private Limited

       (a) Except as provided in paragraph (b) of this general license, all transactions

prohibited by Executive Order (E.O.) 13846 that are ordinarily incident and necessary to

the wind down of any transaction involving Samudra Marine Services Private Limited

(“Samudra”), or any entity in which Samudra owns, directly or indirectly, a 50 percent or

greater interest, are authorized through 12:01 a.m. eastern daylight time, October 23,

2026, provided that any payment to a blocked person must be made into a blocked,

interest-bearing account located in the United States.

       (b) This general license does not authorize any transactions otherwise prohibited

by E.O. 13846, including transactions involving any person blocked pursuant to E.O.

13846 other than the blocked persons described in paragraph (a) of this general license,

unless separately authorized.


[official name omitted]
Director
Office of Foreign Assets Control

Dated: October 8, 2026

Bank for Investment and Finance

(ITSR), that are ordinarily incident and necessary to the wind down of any transaction

involving International Development Bank for Investment and Finance, a.k.a. Iraq

       (b) This general license does not authorize any transactions otherwise prohibited

translation_ja:
## PDF 1ページ

OFACは10月8日発行のイラン関連一般許可EEと、10月15日発行のFFを官報に掲載する。両許可は発行時にウェブで公開した。

## PDF 2ページ

EEの取引縮小許可は2026年10月23日午前0時1分（米東部夏時間）まで。遮断対象者への支払は米国内の利息付き凍結口座に入れる条件。

## PDF 3ページ

FFは指定された銀行及び一定の保有先が関与する取引の縮小に通常付随し必要な取引を、期限・例外・支払の凍結口座条件付きで許可する。
missing_parts: 全3ページを抽出し要点を翻訳。対象先・期限・例外の全文訳、全ページの目視は未了。
